name: The Twilight Zone
description: An anthology series containing drama, psychological thriller, fantasy, science fiction, suspense, and/or horror, often concluding with a macabre or unexpected twist.

videos.title: The Time Element (Pilot) from Desilu Playhouse
videos.overview:
A man (William Bendix) visits a psychoanalyst, complaining about a recurring dream in which he imagines waking up in Honolulu just prior to the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor.

Rod Serling wrote a teleplay intending for it to be the pilot episode of a new series called The Twilight Zone. Although it ended up airing on a different show, Westinghouse Desilu Playhouse S01E06, it is still considered the pilot episode of The Twilight Zone.

videos.title: Submitted For Your Approval
videos.overview: Imagine if you will, a young boy with a monstrous imagination. A lad whose fascination with sci-fi magazines and high school drama kindled a spark that would ignite into one of the brightest creative minds of this century. A young boy by the name of Rod Serling. Embark on a fascinating tour of the life of Rod Serling in this "American Masters" special. Learn the fascinating story of how television's most esteemed and popular writer outwitted stifling sponsor censorship by creating a series devoted entirely to fantasy stories--"The Twilight Zone." While censors looked elsewhere, Serling skillfully wrote "fanciful" tales that dealt with controversial issues of the day. Extensive interviews with key figures such as John Frankenheimer, Jack Klugman, Kim Hunter and Buck Houghton provide a detailed portrait of the man whose innovative work changed the course of television history.

videos.title: Where Is Everybody?
videos.overview: Mike Ferris finds himself in a town strangely devoid of people. But despite the emptiness, he has the odd feeling that he's being watched...

videos.title: One for the Angels
videos.overview: A street salesman cleverly eludes Death. But if he lives, a little girl must die in his place.

videos.title: Mr. Denton on Doomsday
videos.overview: A has-been, drunk gunslinger finds his fast-draw abilities magically restored.

videos.title: The Sixteen-Millimeter Shrine
videos.overview: An aging, former movie star lives and dreams in the past, constantly watching her old movies alone in her room.

videos.title: Walking Distance
videos.overview: A stressed advertising executive, driving through the country, leaves his car and starts to walk toward his hometown, Homewood. He finds things exactly as they were when he was a child.

videos.title: Escape Clause
videos.overview: A hypochondriac exchanges his soul for immortality and indestructibility.

videos.title: The Lonely
videos.overview: In 2046, imprisoned for murder on a distant asteroid, Corry receives an unexpected present that brings a semblance of companionship during his isolation.

videos.title: Time Enough at Last
videos.overview: A bank teller, obsessed with reading, faces conflicts at work and home because of his passion for literature.

videos.title: Perchance to Dream
videos.overview: A man with a heart condition explains to his psychiatrist that he feels extremely tired, because he is terrified of falling asleep for fear he might die.

videos.title: Judgment Night
videos.overview: In 1942, a German wonders why he's on the deck of a British steamship, with no memory of how he got there.

videos.title: And When the Sky Was Opened
videos.overview: Recovering in the hospital after a space mission, Major William Gart is visited by his co-pilot Lieutenant Colonel Clegg Forbes, who insists on the existence of a third astronaut.

videos.title: What You Need
videos.overview: A two-bit thug thinks he's found the key to a better life in an old sidewalk salesman who has the uncanny ability to tell people what they need the most.

videos.title: The Four of Us are Dying
videos.overview: In this noirish tale, a man with the ability to change his face to resemble others gets into hot water with gangsters.

videos.title: Third from the Sun
videos.overview: With all-out nuclear war about to ignite, a scientist and his pilot friend plot to escape on an experimental spaceship.

videos.title: I Shot an Arrow into the Air
videos.overview: Three astronauts crash-land on an unknown planet and must confront survival challenges, unraveling their unity in the face of desperation.

videos.title: The Hitch-Hiker
